questions.q: In Psalm 1, the blessed man is like what, planted by the streams of water?
questions.evidence: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither

questions.q: According to Psalm 19, what declares the glory of God?
questions.evidence: The heavens declare the glory of God

questions.q: "My God, my God," Psalm 22 begins. What does it ask next?
questions.evidence: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me
Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing

questions.q: In Psalm 23, through which valley will the psalmist fear no evil?
questions.evidence: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me

questions.q: "Yahweh is my light and my" what, in Psalm 27?
questions.evidence: Yahweh is my light and my salvation

questions.q: As the deer pants for the water brooks, for whom does the psalmist's soul pant?
questions.evidence: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God

questions.q: "Be still, and know that I am" what, in Psalm 46?
questions.evidence: Be still, and know that I am God

questions.q: What does David ask God to create in him, in Psalm 51?
questions.evidence: Create in me a clean heart, O God

questions.q: In Psalm 139, how does the psalmist say he is made?
questions.evidence: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made

questions.q: How far does Psalm 103 say God has removed our sins from us?
options: As far as the east is from the west
questions.evidence: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us
answerTerms: as far as the east is from the west

questions.q: In Psalm 119, what is God's word to the psalmist's feet?
questions.evidence: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path

questions.q: "I will lift up my eyes to the" what, in Psalm 121?
questions.evidence: I will lift up my eyes to the hills

questions.q: By the rivers of which city did the captives sit down and weep?
questions.evidence: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down

questions.q: In the last psalm, what is called on to praise Yah?
questions.evidence: Let everything that has breath praise Yah
